verses.text: Yahweh told Moses, ‘Now you’ll see what I’m about to do to Pharaoh. I’ll use my mighty hand, and he’ll let them go—he’ll drive them out of his land.’ 💪
God spoke to Moses: ‘I am Yahweh. 📣
‘I appeared to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob as God Almighty, but I wasn’t known to them by my name Yahweh. 📜
‘I also made my covenant with them: I promised to give them Canaan, the land where they traveled and lived as foreigners. 🤝
‘I’ve heard the Israelites groaning under Egyptian slavery, and I’ve remembered my covenant. 😢
‘So tell the Israelites: “I am Yahweh. I’ll bring you out from under Egypt’s heavy burdens, free you from slavery, and rescue you with my outstretched arm and mighty acts of judgment. 🛡️
“‘I’ll take you as my own people, and I’ll be your God. Then you’ll know I’m Yahweh your God—the one who brought you out from under Egypt’s burdens. 🤝
“‘I’ll bring you into the land I promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I’ll give it to you as your own. I am Yahweh.’” 🗺️
Moses told this to the Israelites, but they didn’t listen. Their spirits were crushed by harsh slavery. 😔
Then Yahweh spoke to Moses: 📣
‘Go tell Pharaoh, Egypt’s king, to let the Israelites leave his land.’ 📨
Moses answered Yahweh, ‘Look, the Israelites didn’t listen to me. Why would Pharaoh listen? I struggle to speak clearly.’ 😟
Yahweh gave Moses and Aaron a command for the Israelites and for Pharaoh, Egypt’s king: bring the Israelites out of Egypt. 📣
These are the heads of their family groups. Reuben was Israel’s firstborn; his sons were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi. These are Reuben’s clans. 👨‍👦
Simeon’s sons were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, whose mother was a Canaanite woman. These were Simeon’s clans. 👨‍👦
Here are Levi’s sons by their family lines: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. Levi lived 137 years. 🌳
Gershon’s sons were Libni and Shimei, with their own family lines. 👨‍👦
Kohath’s sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. Kohath lived 133 years. 🌳
Merari’s sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the Levite clans by family line. 👨‍👦
Amram married Jochebed, his father’s sister. She gave birth to Aaron and Moses. Amram lived 137 years. 👨‍👩‍👦
Izhar’s sons were Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri. 👨‍👦
Uzziel’s sons were Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri. 👨‍👦
Aaron married Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon. She gave birth to Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. 👨‍👩‍👦
Korah’s sons were Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These were the Korahite clans. 👨‍👦
Eleazar son of Aaron married one of Putiel’s daughters, and she gave birth to Phinehas. These were the heads of the Levite families and clans. 👨‍👩‍👦
This is the same Aaron and Moses Yahweh told, ‘Bring the Israelites out of Egypt in their organized groups.’ 📜
These are the same Moses and Aaron who spoke to Pharaoh, Egypt’s king, about bringing Israel out of Egypt. 🗣️
On the day Yahweh spoke to Moses in Egypt, 🗓️
he told him, ‘I am Yahweh. Tell Pharaoh, Egypt’s king, everything I tell you.’ 📣
Moses answered Yahweh, ‘I struggle to speak clearly. How will Pharaoh listen to me?’ 😟
